note: Canned public Kalshi market/series payloads for research tests (shapes from api.elections.kalshi.com, Nov 2026). No network in CI.

weather_market.title: Will the maximum temperature be <57° on Nov 9, 2026?
weather_market.rules_primary: If the maximum temperature recorded at New York City (CLINYC) for Nov 9, 2026, is less than 57° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
weather_market.rules_secondary: Not all weather data is the same. The official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

crypto_market.title: Bitcoin price on Nov 9, 2026?
crypto_market.rules_primary: If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) before 2 AM EST is above 74999.99 at 2 AM EST on Nov 9, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
crypto_market.rules_secondary: Not all cryptocurrency price data is the same. The price used to determine this market is based on CF Benchmarks' corresponding Real Time Index (RTI).

sports_market.title: Atlanta at Green Bay Winner?
sports_market.rules_primary: If Green Bay wins the Atlanta vs Green Bay Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 9, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
sports_market.rules_secondary: If the game is postponed, the market will resolve per the contract terms.

econ_market.title: Fed holds rates in December 2026?
econ_market.rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve leaves the upper bound of the federal funds target range unchanged at its December 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
